mstts:express-as.prosody: As we wrap up our journey together, just think about this—God’s joy isn’t some distant idea, or a feeling reserved for a select few. It’s the very heartbeat of reality, the source behind every real and lasting happiness you’ve ever known. When you understand what truly brings God delight, you start to unlock the secret to a life that’s meaningful and full of wonder. So, here’s what this means for you: God’s joy is rooted in His own glory—it’s not about what we achieve. The love shared between the Father and the Son? That’s the foundation of every real love story. God finds pleasure in the beauty of creation, in justice and mercy, and in seeing lives transformed. And here’s the amazing part—obedience, faith, and prayer aren’t meant to weigh you down. They’re invitations to step right into God’s joy. Every ordinary moment you experience? It’s a chance to reflect, to join in, and to share in the pleasures of God. To bring all of this together, don’t forget—you’re invited into this joy, not just as an observer, but as a participant. God’s pleasure isn’t something you have to admire from the sidelines. It’s a call to live differently, to see every day with new eyes, to discover meaning in the simple things, and find hope even when life is hard. You don’t have to earn God’s delight. You’re welcomed into it, just as you are. Let that truth shape the way you worship, the way you work, the way you love others, and even the way you dream. Because when you live in the light of God’s joy, you step into a story that’s so much bigger, deeper, and more beautiful than you ever imagined. And in that story, you’ll discover a happiness that lasts—a joy that’s yours, and God’s, forever woven together.
